name: Periodic Automated Bug Sweep
prompt:
Perform periodic bug sweep: fetch open issues using `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels`, scan the codebase for previously unknown bugs (unhandled exceptions, resource leaks, broken error paths, type inconsistencies, race conditions). name: Periodic Ready-for-PR Backlog Processing
prompt: Perform periodic ready-for-pr backlog processing: query open issues labeled `ready-for-pr` using `gh issue list --state open --label "ready-for-pr" --json number,title,body`, select the oldest unassigned or pending issue without an open PR, create a feature branch, execute local unit tests, and draft an initial PR.

name: Periodic PR Hygiene & Conflict Sweep
prompt: Perform periodic PR hygiene sweep: query open automated pull requests using `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,headRefName,mergeable`, inspect for merge conflicts or failing presubmit checks, and post status notifications or trigger automated code fixes.
